summary: A Sydney agency with property and financial services under one brand is a strength, but broken images and malformed phone links appear to cost you appraisal requests.

findings.problem: Most images appear to load the same placeholder file instead of real photos, and image text appears as file names such as 'image (33)_81_25'.
findings.cost: A seller judging an agency on first look sees blank pictures and loses confidence.
findings.fix: Real optimised photos with proper descriptions.

findings.problem: The Highland Marine phone link appears to read 'tel:0295440888or0404014595' and the footer phone link appears to contain spaces.
findings.cost: A mobile visitor who taps to call may get a failed call.
findings.fix: Separate, correctly formatted click to call links.

findings.problem: The Financial Services button appears to point to one website while the section uses another, and the Property Alerts menu item appears to link to #open-login-form.
findings.cost: Visitors are sent to the wrong site or a dead item.

findings.problem: The Enquire now form appears to have no message field, 'Please choose' appears as visible text on the appraisal form, and the Vue project text appears cut off.
findings.cost: Thin forms and cut text lose appraisal requests.
findings.fix: A complete appraisal form and finished copy.

redesign: Correct buttons and a complete appraisal form.
